county.label: New York City (all five boroughs)
county.basis: the five boroughs' underlying counts added together, with the measure recomputed from the totals
county.moe_reason: every component is controlled to an independent population estimate, so the combined figure carries no sampling error. This is not a measured margin of error of zero.
